info.title: API.SH: TheTVDB
info.description: The TheTVDB API from API.SH: public TheTVDB data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: A network, studio or production company with its series and movies
get.description:
One company: info (id, country, primary type, parent and child companies, company type, external links) and the series and movies it is credited on (name, slug, poster).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thetvdb-company

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Company slug (`amc`), number or a thetvdb.com company link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: One episode: info, translations, cast and crew

One episode: title, season, English overview, image, info (originally aired, runtime, content ratings, network, production companies, external links, created and modified dates with their contributors' usernames), the title and overview in every language, and its guest stars, directors and writers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thetvdb-episode

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Episode id (from `/thetvdb/v1/series/episodes`) or a thetvdb.com episode link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Search series, movies, people, companies and lists
get.description:
Searches TheTVDB: each hit with type, TheTVDB id, name, slug, year, first air date, country, language, network, companies, genres, status, overview, image, external ids and follower count, plus facet counts (type, country, language, year, network, genre) for the whole result. Filters narrow it. Pages with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thetvdb-search

get.summary: Series: every info field, translations, seasons, cast and crew, lists, artwork

One series: TheTVDB id, name, image, English overview, info (status, first and most recent air date, airs, network, production companies, runtime, genres, country, language, sub-genres, settings, time period, external links such as IMDb and official site, favorited count, created and modified dates with the contributors who made them, `created_by` / `modified_by`), the title and overview in every language with aliases, seasons per order (aired, DVD, absolute ...) with date range and episode count, cast with characters and crew (directors, writers ...), lists it is in, and artwork URLs by type (posters, backgrounds, banners, clear logos ...).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thetvdb-series

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
